description:
List SMS conversations. Optionally filter by agent_id to see conversations for a specific agent.

Each conversation is a thread between your number and an external contact, with its ID, participant, message count, and last-message preview.

agent_id.description: Show only conversations handled by this agent (ID from list_agents).

limit.description: How many conversations to return in one page.

offset.description: How many conversations to skip before this page, for paging.

name: list_conversations

agentId.description: ID of the agent on this thread, or null.

id.description: The conversation's unique ID (use as conversation_id).

lastMessageAt.description: Time of the most recent message (ISO 8601), or null.

lastMessagePreview.description: Short preview of the latest message.

metadata.description: Custom state stored on the conversation, or null.

participant.description: The external contact's number in E.164 format.

phoneNumberId.description: ID of your phone number in this thread.

hasMore.description: Whether more results exist beyond this page.

total.description: Total matching records across all pages.

title: List Conversations
